name: Sheraton Imperial Kuala Lumpur Hotel
short_description: A long-established Sheraton on Jalan Sultan Ismail, steps from LRT and Monorail stations in the Golden Triangle.
ai_summary: Sheraton Imperial Kuala Lumpur Hotel is a long-running property on Jalan Sultan Ismail in the Golden Triangle, described by Marriott as a grande dame among the city's hotels, and sits just steps from LRT and Monorail stations. Guest reviews consistently highlight the location's transit access -- the Monorail makes reaching Bukit Bintang and Berjaya Times Square straightforward, and the Petronas Towers are within walking distance for guests who don't mind a stroll. Rooms are frequently described as large and comfortable, with king-size beds and views that can take in Merdeka 118, KL Tower, or the Petronas Twin Towers depending on the room. Staff are repeatedly called warm and willing to help, and the dining and gym facilities draw positive mentions. The most common watchouts concern the building's age: some areas are described as feeling outdated even though core cleanliness is generally well regarded, and a handful of reviews mention occasional housekeeping lapses or service inconsistency, along with unclear pricing for some add-ons. It suits travelers who prioritize transit connectivity and room space over the newest design, and who want a dependable, well-located full-service hotel.

faqs.question: Is Sheraton Imperial Kuala Lumpur Hotel well connected by public transport?
faqs.answer: Yes -- the hotel is steps from LRT and Monorail stations, making it easy to reach Bukit Bintang and Berjaya Times Square, and the Petronas Twin Towers are within walking distance for guests who don't mind about a 30-minute stroll.

faqs.question: Are the rooms at Sheraton Imperial Kuala Lumpur Hotel outdated?
faqs.answer: Some areas of the hotel are described by guests as feeling dated given its age, though rooms are still frequently praised for their size and comfort, with king-size beds and views of landmarks like Merdeka 118, KL Tower, or the Petronas Twin Towers.

reviews.title: Review: Sheraton Imperial Kuala Lumpur (King Room)
reviews.author: Fai
reviews.summary: Points-stay review of a 42sqm King Room on the 35th floor. Praises the fresh post-renovation decor and Club Lounge, but dings the lack of an in-room coffee machine. Rated a solid Marriott property.

reviews.title: Hotel Review: Sheraton Imperial Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
reviews.author: wareontheglobe
reviews.summary: Honeymoon stay booked on SPG points. Pleasantly surprised by a spacious suite, central location and a generous 37th-floor Club Lounge with breakfast and evening happy hour. Would return.

reviews.title: The Sheraton Imperial Kuala Lumpur (Review): Best Anniversary Ever!
reviews.author: Laura Cody
reviews.summary: Anniversary stay in a corner Club Suite on the 33rd floor with 90-degree city views. Loved the space, Club floor perks and vegan-friendly dining at Celestial Court and Villa Danieli.
